record: Antiquities Advisory Board Historic Building Appraisal 590
facts: Built 1937 to a symmetrical rounded triangular plan. The surviving Streamline Moderne façade has white render, dark canopy edging, projecting concrete fins, large window bands and circular piloti.

record: URA and Development Bureau core-elements preservation brief, 2008
facts: The southwest market entrance, curved canopy, fins and part of the front structure were preserved in situ during redevelopment. The associated tower uses a pale white-grey palette, rounded corners, and horizontal window ledges.

record: Urban Renewal Authority final project record
facts: The One Wanchai phase was completed in 2013. Active replacement market premises are located in the separate Zenith development.
